summary: Find out the hidden words in the wheel of luck and increase your fame score!
description: Have fun with this special wheel of luck game! Senior Games presents "The Wheel of Fame" to guess words, sentences or names while increasing your fame and popularity. You will love this game! The mechanics of the game are similar to Hangman game: you must play against two more players to get the word or sentence hidden in the panel. To do this, you will have to spin the wheel of luck, choose the vowels and consonants you want and win the maximum possible points in each game. Beware of falling into the bankruptcy cell! When you spin the wheel you can get points, lifelines and duplicate letters. But don't trust yourself! You can also fall into the bankruptcy cell and lose it all or miss your turn. If you have enough points, you can buy a vowel to make it easier to guess the hidden phrase. WHEEL OF FAME CATEGORIES - Proverbs and popular sayings - Singer and song - Movie and actor/actress - Countries and capitals - Books and writers and much more! BECOME FAMOUS This wheel of luck is special because the goal is to be the most popular and famous player. To do this, you will need to get the maximum number of diamonds and get clothes and accessories that help you raise your level of popularity. The more fame, the more fans will be waiting for you on the red carpet! FEATURES - Attractive and colorful design - Thousands of words to guess - Funny hosts that will guide you in the game - Possibility of getting lifelines in the wheel to continue playing - Customize your avatar with amazing clothes and accessories - Increase your popularity with diamonds and dazzle your fans on the red carpet - Game for all ages - Free offline games ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability, which make our games ideal for older people or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.
